client_context_facts.birth_time_source: No birth certificate; family estimate is between 21:00 and 23:00, traditionally the Hai hour.
residence_and_family_business: Moved to Shanghai around 2003 because both parents were doing business there; lived there about four years and also studied elsewhere.
Returned to the hometown around 2008 for school.
client_context_facts.family_relationship: Parents generally had a harmonious relationship; no reported long-term parental conflict, family property dispute or sustained caregiving burden.
client_context_facts.relationship_history: First clearly significant relationship was in early 2017; no long-term relationship history or major breakup was reported before the 2021 event.
client_context_facts.family_asset_context: Parents originally held the investment property; the title was temporarily under the client's name. After sale, the proceeds were transferred in one lump sum, with no ongoing repayment demand, and are treated as the client's personal home-purchase funds.
client_context_facts.maternal_illness_context: Mother was diagnosed with leukemia around June 2024, underwent two rounds of chemotherapy, did not continue the third round, and spent the final period at a temple before dying in the early evening of 2025-08-30.

strict_receptions.logic: Mercury in Scorpio, Mars in Virgo

natal_core.reception_boundary: The strict mutual reception is Mercury–Mars; it is not a Sun–Venus or 2nd-ruler–4th-ruler mutual reception. Venus is in Libra, its own domicile.

insight_cards.rule: Personal wealth is placed in the family/property field; the Mercury–Mars reception creates a two-way channel between family/property paperwork and money/career/children responsibilities.
insight_cards.inference: Family property can become a material source entering the person's own asset management, while personal funds and work income can also be directed back into property and family obligations.
insight_cards.observable_manifestation: Parents' investment-house sale proceeds were transferred in one lump sum to the client and designated for personal home purchase.
insight_cards.counter_test: 2nd ruler in 4th alone does not prove parental gifts; a clean 4th-ruler-in-2nd structure would be more direct.

insight_cards.rule: The career ruler placed in the money house makes work and income a direct delivery path; the 6th/9th Jupiter chain adds service, training and institutional work.
insight_cards.inference: Employment changes can directly affect cashflow, while education, institutional experience and practical work routines are part of the career mechanism.
insight_cards.observable_manifestation: Military service, graduate admission, 2024 employment entry and sudden employment exit formed a dated career/institutional sequence.

insight_cards.rule: The home axis is carried through movement, documents, schooling and institutional transitions rather than only through family conflict or property ownership.
insight_cards.inference: Residence and education repeatedly reorganize one another across life stages.
insight_cards.observable_manifestation: Moves between Hunan, Shanghai, other study locations and the hometown in 2000, 2003, 2008 and 2015.
insight_cards.counter_test: Parental relationship was described as generally harmonious; the 4th-house emphasis should not be translated into family conflict.

evidence: 2024 Mars profection and tertiary Moon–Mars contact
insight_cards.rule: Health, daily work and income can become one event chain when the 6th-house condition and 10th-ruler/2nd-house placement are simultaneously activated.
insight_cards.inference: An acute health disruption can immediately affect attendance and employment, but the chart does not diagnose the medical cause.
insight_cards.observable_manifestation: December 2024 acute gastrointestinal illness affected attendance, followed by a sudden layoff notice and formal departure on December 31.

insight_cards.rule: Derived houses must be read from the relevant house: the 2nd from the 4th describes the parents' movable assets and resources. Its ruler placed in the native's 2nd can describe parents' assets entering the native's personal wealth.
insight_cards.inference: Parental property support is structurally possible without requiring a literal 4th-ruler-in-2nd placement. The 4th-to-5th-to-2nd chain, reinforced by 2nd ruler in 4th and Mercury–Mars reception, is a specific asset-transfer mechanism.
insight_cards.observable_manifestation: In July 2023, parents sold an investment property and transferred the proceeds in one lump sum to the client for personal home purchase.
insight_cards.counter_test: This is a derived-house inference, not proof of recurring support or property appreciation. The transaction date remains month-level and the late-time house-cusp branch must be compared.

consensus: The deepest property finding is 4th-house parents -> 2nd from the 4th (5th) -> Mars in 2nd, reinforced by 2nd ruler Sun in 4th and Mercury–Mars mutual reception.
Career volatility is more likely to show through contracts, authority boundaries and institutional conditions than a sudden loss of ability.
Residence, parental business, education and institutional transitions form one 4th/3rd/6th/9th infrastructure chain.
The strongest rectification discriminator remains the pre/post-22:27 annual-lord chain, with a second major cusp branch around 22:54-22:55.
limits: Do not use the Mercury–Mars reception as a Sun–Venus or 2nd-ruler–4th-ruler mutual reception.
Do not turn the family asset transfer into a claim of lifelong parental allowance or property-price appreciation.
Do not use family illness or death for medical diagnosis or deterministic mortality claims.
